{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Cuisine of India]] | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]]

This dish is extremely creamy and rich; don't expect to be able to eat much of it. It goes very well with [[Cookbook:Indian Beans|Indian beans]] and [[Cookbook:Indian Rice|Indian rice]].

==Ingredients==
* 6 small [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], peeled and cut in half
* 2 small cans [[Cookbook:coconut|coconut milk]]
* ½ can [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]]
* 2 cloves [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:Red pepper flakes|red pepper flakes]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive oil|Olive oil]]
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste

==Procedure==
# Sauté the garlic in olive oil.
# Add tomatoes. Cook for 10 minutes, until the oil and tomatoes separate (they will bubble).
# Stir in the coconut milk.
# Add ½ teaspoon red pepper, and salt to taste. Boil it all together.
# Add the potatoes. Cook over low-medium heat until the potatoes are done. They will become fairly soft; check with a fork.
